entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling about the VeloBand Pulse I just bought. It's not working correctly and I'd like to return it.

I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand Pulse. I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's a technical fault. The heart rate monitor is completely inaccurate. It's showing my resting heart rate at 150 bpm while I'm sitting on the couch. For tracking my workouts, it's basically a piece of garbage.

I see, that definitely sounds frustrating. An accurate heart rate is the most important feature. I can connect you with our technical support team. They have some advanced diagnostics they can run to get that sorted out for you.

Look, I appreciate the offer, but I really don't have time to go through a long troubleshooting process. I've already tried restarting it and unpairing it. Honestly, I just want my money back. I'd like to start the process for a refund.
I understand completely. You just want a product that works right out of the box. Let me pull up your order information and check our return policy. One moment please.

Okay, thanks for your patience. I'm looking at our internal policy here... and it says all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. I see your band was delivered eight days ago, so you are well within that window.
Oh, great. So I can send it back then?

Yes, absolutely. Since you're within the 90-day period, I can go ahead and approve that return for you right now. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label. Just pack the VeloBand Pulse in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
That's perfect. Simple and easy. Thank you for your help, David.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you quickly. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again.
Alright. Have a great day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
